sdkCandidate.note: Candidate pins from official release/tag sources; integrator verifies compatibility without a project-wide upgrade.

securityInvariants: Accounts mode enabled and verified nonempty server-bound account UUID before every private filesystem, cache, audit, export or background action.
No ambient/global fallback, empty withAccount, platform impersonation or client-supplied tenant selection.
No MCP token passthrough as manager JWT; no manager token, OAuth secret, password or private phone in widget/model/URL/log.
Per-request issuer, audience, signature/time, active grant, account ownership and required scope checks; session ID is not authentication.
Strict source validator/preflight plus narrower MVP authoring policy; no independent persisted game format.
Only trusted compiled bundled renderer/assets; untrusted TSX, private media and package installer are not activated.
One-use server-recorded first-party POST consent bound to exact save input; model booleans and UI visibility never authorize save.
Same-title and crash-safe composite persistence required before enabling account saves.
All proposed runtime controls require actual acceptance evidence.

mvpPolicy.media: Authorized immutable public bundled assets only

oauth.dcr: Compatibility only after explicit reviewed requirements
oauth.refresh: Only if enabled; rotate public-client refresh tokens and revoke family on reuse

oauth.accountMapping: Active server-side subject/grant to account UUID; theme-workspace delegation deferred

ui.bridge: Official ext-apps App/useApp; no custom permissive bridge

mutation.saveConsent: First-party authenticated CSRF-protected POST creates one-use decision bound to exact revision/digest/key/new target; no bearer in URL

mutation.crashRecovery: Durable key-to-quiz mapping with outcome reconciliation through existing composite service; do not edit storage owner's lease
